::: {#rem-cook-levin-source}
#### Where NP-completeness comes from

Stephen Cook and Leonid Levin proved @thm-cook-levin independently in the early 1970s;
@arora2009computational [section 2.3] give a proof.
Once one problem is known to be NP-complete,
@thm-np-complete-by-reduction gives others,
one reduction at a time.
@arora2009computational [section 2.4] prove @thm-indset-np-complete this way,
reducing a version of SAT to INDSET.

:::
